limits: System proxy per service: preflight keeps in memory the prior and applied managed fields (the nine NetworkSettingsKind.proxies keys) of every systemProxy journal record scoped to a stable location and service identity, and requires the saved preferences.plist (the store SystemNetworkLocationStore reads; read-only, bounded, twice around each journal read) to hold exactly each record's applied fields, or the cycle does not begin. After Stop each released identity is compared with the prior captured at preflight; after Quit with the prior Start's record tracked, or the preflight prior for identities Start did not record. A Start prior that any restore group rebased onto the preflight applied fields is unproven; a route that is its prior is rebased_prior_held, unproven unless the per-service check fails or is pending, never attention and never blamed on Conduit's apply. Exact equality is restored; a restore group still holding the applied generation fails; any other difference is attention, an external value restoration preserves by design whose writer is not attributed; a retained record is pending; unreadable values, changed membership or an absent protocol are unproven. Untracked services, which policy preserves as the user's, are not judged. Values follow the product's projection and request validation except the bypass-entry grammar. Identities and field sets are reported only as HMACs under a per-run key that is never written.

System proxy route: the active, global scutil --proxy settings are checked for an enabled route to Conduit's own listeners (loopback PAC URL at its local PAC port, loopback HTTP/HTTPS proxy at its proxy port); routes elsewhere are not judged. Its ownership is classified from the exact endpoint (full PAC URL, or host and port, each enabled): exactly a captured prior that an enabled service of the current active location holds now, with every captured identity restored, is attention (preexisting route preserved); one matching only an applied generation, or nothing, fails; unknown is unproven. A global view a runtime publisher such as a VPN client supplies is not attributed beyond that exact match. Global reads converge within the same settle bound as the per-service comparison, since the saved commit can precede configd's global view. An explicitly empty scutil dictionary counts as no route. scutil's exact no-configuration message counts only when a second read-only query of the global proxy key answers exactly that the key does not exist; any other answer, and blank, truncated or unrecognized output, stays unproven. system_proxy_read gives the read status, shape and absence_check of those reads, never their values; the enable flags come from a separate read.

Start's first running snapshot precedes its platform work, so the Start journal trace waits up to the settle bound for the proxy member's lifecycle.module_settled; if that is not observed as started, the Quit per-service comparison cannot pass.
Resolver files and launchd variables are compared only against priors the starting journal recorded; anything the journal did not record is not judged.
Quit timing runs from the owner's Return press to the observed process exit, so it includes the owner's reaction time. It is an upper bound on the product's quit, not a measurement of it.

Relaunch open_to_serving_s runs from `open -n` to the first fresh running snapshot with an accepting listener. It includes any time before the proxy was started, by the owner or otherwise, and is not a measurement of startup latency.
Connections rows are the owner's attestation, not tool evidence.
Startup warnings (client read ECONNRESET, one PAC not_loaded) are not judged by this run.
scope: Installed locally certificate-signed 0.6.0 candidate, not release-certificate package; exact per-service physical restoration for eight journal-scoped services. No general cleanup guarantee for untracked services. Relaunch requires owner Start and is not automatic-start latency.

review_qualification.after_quit_global_route: Unproven: the selected read is an empty dictionary, but a later read in the same phase has PAC enabled with endpoint unrecorded. Do not claim no global own-route. Raw check counts/outcomes remain unchanged.
review_qualification.physical_restoration: Accepted: all8 tracked managed fields match the captured priors afterStop andQuit; no appliedretained/externaldiff/rebased/unknown. Existing policy preserves untracked priors, even an own-looking PAC.
